description: Eight production-quality starter skills shipped with WeBrain so the Skillhub Marketplace is non-empty on first install. All are deterministic, dependency-free, and demonstrate the skill SDK shape without calling out to the network.

skills.name: Clean URL
skills.description: Strip tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, mc_*, ref, etc.) from a URL and return the cleaned link.

skills.name: Slugify
skills.description: Convert text into a URL-safe slug (lowercase, hyphens, ASCII). Handles CJK by stripping or transliterating to dash.

skills.name: JSON Pretty
skills.description: Parse a JSON string and re-emit it pretty-printed (2-space indent), with a clear error if the input is invalid.

skills.name: Word Count
skills.description: Report word / char / line counts for a chunk of text. Words are split on whitespace; CJK characters count individually.

skills.name: Markdown TOC
skills.description: Extract H1-H6 headings from a markdown document and render a nested table of contents with GitHub-style anchor links.

skills.name: CSV Headers
skills.description: Read a CSV file path and report its header row + row count. No pandas dependency — uses stdlib csv module.

skills.name: Base64 Decode
skills.description: Decode a base64-encoded string (standard or URL-safe variant) and return the UTF-8 text, with a clear error on invalid input.

skills.name: UUID Generator
skills.description: Generate N random UUID v4 strings (default 1). Useful when scaffolding tests, fixtures, or session IDs.
